topic: Imu is on a clock: his ailment, his admitted limit in chapter 1198 and his long stay away from Mary Geoise make him dangerous in a different way
title: Imu's Ailment Is A Ticking Clock Over Elbaph
description: Imu's biggest weakness on Elbaph may be the distance from Mary Geoise. Chapter 1162 gave him an ailment, chapter 1178 sent him to Elbaph, and in 1198 he admits his limit. Here is why a man on a clock has nothing left to hold back.
comment: Is Imu's ailment a real weakness, or does a man on a clock only get more dangerous? Pick one.

lines.text: Imu's biggest weakness isn't Luffy. It's the distance from Mary Geoise.

shot.fallback: masked ruler on a throne in a vast white palace

lines.text: Chapter 1162 says he can't leave Mary Geoise without his ailment acting up.

shot.fallback: ruler gripping his chest on a throne

lines.text: Then in chapter 1198, inside his own head, he admits he has hit his limit.

shot.fallback: colossal evil god looming over a forest

lines.text: If he doesn't get back to Mary Geoise soon, his life is in real danger.

shot.fallback: dark ruler glaring across a battlefield

lines.text: And he says it in the same fight where he becomes a god the size of an Ancient Giant.

shot.fallback: giant evil god towering over trees

lines.text: In chapter 1178, he told the Elders to rule in his stead and left with Mary Geoise still in flames.

shot.fallback: white palace city on fire at dusk

lines.text: So he's stuck far from home while his seat of power is exposed.

shot.fallback: ruler standing alone in a giant forest

lines.text: Here's my read. A man with a clock has nothing left to hold back, and that makes him more dangerous.
So what does a man on a clock do when a pirate shows up that he can't predict?

shot.fallback: masked ruler facing a rubber pirate

lines.text: And that's why I think Imu's biggest weakness isn't Luffy...

shot.fallback: masked ruler looking toward a distant palace

self_check.hook: line 1 names the character and the claim
